Usage: agentcage cage run [OPTIONS] SCAFFOLD [EXTRA_ARGS]...

  Run a coding agent in a sandboxed cage.

  Examples:
    agentcage run claude-code -s ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
    agentcage run codex --project /path/to/repo -s OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...
    agentcage run claude-code --isolation vm -s ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
    agentcage run claude-code --no-cache --pull -s ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
    agentcage run codex --name my-session -s OPENAI_API_KEY -- codex --help

  Secrets: every secret a scaffold declares is required. `run` aborts
  before starting the cage if one is missing — supply it with `-s KEY`
  (prompts) / `-s KEY=VALUE`, or via a configured `source:`. A scaffold
  that lists alternative credentials under `auth:` needs only one of them:
  the one given with `-s`, else one the scaffold allows from the
  environment (claude-code: an exported CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN from
  `claude setup-token`), which is stored like `-s` and never enters the
  cage. `--no-cache`/`--pull` force a clean rebuild (ignore the layer cache
  / re-pull the base image) across every isolation backend — container,
  vm, and apple-container alike.

Options:
  --project PATH                  Project directory to mount (default: current
                                  directory).
  --name TEXT                     Cage name (default: auto-generated).
  -s, --set-secret TEXT           Set a secret (KEY=VALUE or KEY to prompt).
                                  Repeatable.
  -v, --verbose                   Show full build output.
  --isolation [container|vm|apple-container]
                                  Isolation backend (default: auto-detect from
                                  platform).
  --as-root                       Run the session as root (uid 0) instead of the
                                  workload's uid 1000 user (debug only).
  --time                          Echo per-phase wall times and print a summary
                                  on completion.
  --no-cache                      Force a full image rebuild (ignore podman's
                                  layer cache).
  --pull                          Force re-pull of the base image from the
                                  registry.
  --rm                            Destroy the cage and its scoped resources
                                  after the session. The cage's audit data
                                  directory is kept.
  --keep                          Keep the stopped cage, its volumes and
                                  secrets after the session (default).
  --dry-run                       Render and validate the config, print the
                                  plan, and exit without changing anything.
  --no-color                      Disable colored output.
  --quiet                         Suppress progress output (spinners and banners).
  -h, --help                      Show this message and exit.
